task_description: Write a method in Dafny to find the list of maximum length in a list of lists.
specification_response:
method MaxLengthLists(lists: seq<seq<int>>) returns (maxLists: seq<seq<int>>)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The result contains all sublists from the input lists that have the maximum length
    - Every list in the result has a length equal to the maximum length among all input lists
    - All lists in the result are sublists of the original input lists (i.e., they are equal to some element in the input)
